reviews.body:
## Code Review

This pull request fixes a bug in @firebase/data-connect where a query subscription whose initial transport connection failed was left registered, preventing subsequent subscriptions to the same query from reaching the transport. This is resolved by wrapping the invokeSubscribe call in a try-catch block within QueryManager.ts and deleting the registered callback if an error is thrown. A corresponding unit test has been added to verify this retry behavior. There are no review comments, so I have no feedback to provide.
